814.notes: Chrome on Windows 11 (English), CI build with Craft Conductor's own folder named with Japanese letters on C: (short names on). New vanilla 26.3 server: Craft Conductor downloaded Java 25 into its folder and started it by the short name (C:\cc\V030~2.1-C\...\java.exe), which gets past the launcher, but the server didn't start: the JVM looks for lib\modules and net.dll under its long path with the Japanese letters as ??? (UnsatisfiedLinkError ... net.dll: Can't find dependent libraries); the setup rolled back cleanly. Checked by hand: started by short name or through a directory junction, java -version works and java.home is the short/junction path, but running any jar fails the same way, because Windows resolves jvm.dll's own path to the real long one. So #139's short-name fix only fixes java -version, not running servers.
